title: Independent audit of durable offline Solana address-mining report storage
objective: Independently audit the offline PostgreSQL store for Solana daily/weekly address-mining reports: structured-only persistence, idempotent run identity, visible degradation on configured store failure, validation before SQL, migration safety, and absence of live database, scheduler, or network execution.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify source, migrations, or tests.
Do not connect to or deploy PostgreSQL or Redis.
Do not activate a scheduler or perform live provider, RPC, database, Redis, or HTTP calls.
Do not activate BSC or unpark SOL-E2E-001.
